description: Source code for the ReportingUploader class implementation, handling report uploads with preflight checks, request management, and response handling in the Chromium project.

classes.name: ReportingUploaderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ReportingUploader interface, managing report uploads, preflight checks, and response handling.

classes.name: PendingUpload
classes.description: Represents a pending report upload, including state, request details, and callback.

methods.name: StartPreflightRequest
methods.description: Initiates a CORS preflight OPTIONS request to verify server permissions before sending the actual report payload.

methods.name: StartPayloadRequest
methods.description: Starts the actual POST request to upload the report payload, setting headers and upload stream.

methods.name: HandlePreflightResponse
methods.description: Processes the server response to the preflight request, checking for success and CORS headers.

methods.name: HandlePayloadResponse
methods.description: Processes the server response after the payload upload, determining success or failure.
